metadata.title: Container Host OS Security

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securing operating systems that host container runtimes by minimizing attack surface, maintaining configuration integrity, and aligning lifecycle management with container workloads.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container host operating systems, minimal OS distributions, kernel configurations, and supporting system services.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for securing the operating system layer that hosts container runtimes, focusing on kernel exposure, configuration stability, and lifecycle hygiene.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Container host OS security assumes a trusted physical or virtualized execution substrate.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Host OS considerations for container platforms, including kernel exposure, OS hardening, and patch alignment.

metadata.remarks: Container Host OS Security defines trust properties required for operating systems that host container runtimes. This pattern makes explicit the risks associated with kernel attack surface, configuration drift, and lifecycle misalignment between host and container workloads, without asserting container runtime or orchestration controls.

components.title: Container Host OS Hardening
components.description: Minimization and hardening of the operating system hosting container runtimes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation via exploitation of unnecessary host OS services or kernel interfaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Reduction of host OS services and kernel interfaces exposed to container workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least functionality enforced on container host operating systems.
Integrity protection for host OS components supporting container execution.

components.title: Container Host Patching Alignment
components.description: Kernel and OS patching aligned to container runtime behavior and workload risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of unpatched kernel or OS vulnerabilities affecting all container workloads.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Timely remediation of kernel and OS vulnerabilities on container hosts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Flaw remediation applied to container host operating systems.
Vulnerability identification for container host OS components.

components.title: Container Host Configuration Drift Detection
components.description: Detection of unauthorized or unintended configuration changes on container host operating systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Modification of host OS configuration to persist or evade detection in container environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring and detection of configuration drift on container host operating systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Configuration change control for container host operating systems.
Continuous monitoring of container host OS configuration state.
